project.description: Automated CI/CD Pipeline for CSE30040 Cloud Computing and DevOps Lab 5. Clones source code from GitHub (krishbhensdadia21/cloud-cicd-lab), builds Docker image (cloud-app), and deploys container on AWS EC2 Port 5000.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
echo "=== Stage 1: Clone from GitHub ===" rm -rf /tmp/cloud-cicd-lab git clone https://github.com/krishbhensdadia21/cloud-cicd-lab.git /tmp/cloud-cicd-lab cd /tmp/cloud-cicd-lab
echo "=== Stage 2: Build Docker Image ===" docker build -t cloud-app:latest .
echo "=== Stage 3: Continuous Deployment ===" docker stop cloud-app || true docker rm cloud-app || true docker run -d --name cloud-app -p 5000:5000 cloud-app:latest
echo "=== Stage 4: Verify Deployment ===" docker ps | grep cloud-app curl -s http://localhost:5000 | head -n 10 echo "Pipeline Build and Deployment Completed Successfully!"
